result.behaviour_summary: Fixed the serious finding at moonshot_e5.py:282. Previously flags()/debounce() treated a NaN score (the 60-column feature warm-up) as 'outside the set', so at the first evaluable column of every view every in-set name fired at once and the next sessions over-flagged; flags depended on where the window started. Now: debounce(state, known) requires each of the trailing DEBOUNCE sessions to be known (finite score / warm features) and outside; flags() passes known = isfinite(score) with state = known & (score >= thr) (NaN-safe); family_flags() passes known = isfinite(f['quiet']) for A0/A1 (a detector state exists once features are warm; an undefined fact at a warm session is a False state, as kod/detectors.py reports no SIGNAL on a None fact). Features keep their 60-column warm-up (FEATURE_WARMUP), so the first flag any window can emit is at column 65 with five real out-of-set sessions behind it; compute() masks WARMUP = 65 columns, and the docstring now says the harness window starts WARMUP (65) sessions before its period. Verified with the reviewer's probe (open_panel 30x200 seed 5, frozen_us_a(1.9)): names in set at session 80 = 9, full-window flags at 80 = 2, shifted-window (slice 20..200) flags at its column 60 = 0 and column 65 = 1 = full column 85; flags before WARMUP = 0 in both windows; flags on the common range 167 = 167 and compute() output identical on the common range. Registry entry in rules/__init__.py untouched (already additive at HEAD).

needs_other_file: idx-signals/idxsig/e5.py (not in this worktree; the harness owner): every discovery/validation/trading window must start moonshot_e5.WARMUP (= 65) sessions before its period, read from the module literal rather than a hard-coded 60; with a 60-session lead-in the first five period sessions can never carry a flag (the debounce's known-history requirement would fall inside the period).

handoff/kod-next-move/synthesis/E5_CEILING_protocol_draft.json 'warmup' entry (read-only reference; whoever freezes research/E5/protocol.json): the text 'WARMUP = 60 literal ... every harness window starts 60 sessions before the period start' should become 'FEATURE_WARMUP = 60 for the features; WARMUP = FEATURE_WARMUP + DEBOUNCE = 65 is the lead-in compute() masks and the harness window starts before its period' (IDX discovery warm-up then covers 65 sessions of TIER_2, features only, no trade).
open_concerns: Semantic choice for A0/A1 'known': a warm session where a detector fact is undefined (creep5v20 NaN for a name with fewer than 20 present sessions in the base window) is treated as a known False state (outside), mirroring kod/detectors.py which reports no SIGNAL on a None fact; only the feature warm-up is 'unknown'. If the protocol wants an undefined fact to be 'unknown' too, pass known = isfinite(f['creep5v20']) & isfinite(f['quiet']) in family_flags() (one-line change; the existing tests would still pass since the fixture names are all present from session 0).

Names not in the ranking pool (not present or untraded) still receive a finite score (ranks 0.5) and so count as known out-of-set sessions for the debounce, as in the reviewer's suggested fix (known = isfinite(score)); a listed name coming off a 5-session trading halt can therefore flag on its first tradeable session if its score is above threshold. This matches the protocol text ('>= 5 sessions outside the top 0.5%') and is prefix-safe; flagged here only because it is a design choice the protocol freeze may want to state.
WARMUP changed from 60 to 65 for compute(); the protocol draft's 'WARMUP = 60 literal' wording is now the feature warm-up only (see needs_other_file). The reviewer explicitly allowed this choice.
